title: ABOUT THE AUTHOR
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR Erin Morgenstern is the author of The Night Circus , a bestseller that has enchanted readers around the world and has been translated into thirty-seven languages. She has a degree in Theatre from Smith College, an ever-growing collection of jewellery made from skeleton keys, and a cat on her lap. She lives in Massachusetts. www.erinmorgenstern.com
